subject.title: feat(agents): add iteration budget for agent loop safety

question: Should `maxToolCallingRounds` become a permanent public config contract that is supported only by the built-in OpenClaw harness and fails before the model call for plugin harnesses?
rationale: The implementation can be repaired mechanically, but automation cannot decide whether the built-in-only limitation and fail-closed operator experience are the intended long-term product contract.

options.title: Approve the narrowed contract
options.body: Accept the single opt-in key and built-in-only enforcement after the package-boundary defect, max-lines failure, and exact-head proof gap are resolved.

options.title: Require harness capability support
options.body: Pause merge until agent harnesses can declare and implement round-limit capability without a hard built-in-only check.

options.title: Keep limits internal
options.body: Decline the public config surface and retain existing loop detection and run-retry controls until a broader runtime-budget design is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrowed contract
recommendation.body: Accept the single opt-in key and built-in-only enforcement after the package-boundary defect, max-lines failure, and exact-head proof gap are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current contract-narrowing follow-up and are the strongest available owner for confirming whether that shape is intentional.
